nom: First Aid Beauty Facial Radiance Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin, including one who also has eczema, report the serum controls oil production without causing pilling, on top of a brightening effect.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum adds a bit of hydration and does not dry out or irritate their skin further, unlike some other niacinamide serums they had tried before.
segments.combination: The reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin reports the serum evened her skin tone remarkably well after years of acne scarring, dark spots and redness.
segments.sensitive: Many reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who call it hypersensitive, describe the serum as gentle and non-irritating even around the eyes, though one with sensitive skin says combining it with the wrong product caused irritation until she adjusted her routine.
segments.normal: The reviewer with normal skin reports only a slight hydration boost and modest fading of her hyperpigmentation, suggesting vitamin C or retinol might work better than this niacinamide serum for non-sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s and 50s report mixed results: several say age spots, old redness or dark blotches fade with consistent daily use, while one 48-year-old used a full bottle without seeing any fading of her hyperpigmentation.

concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers, covering dark spots, melasma, sun spots, age spots and post-acne marks, report visible fading within one to eight weeks of twice-daily use, several comparing it favorably to prescription creams; a notable minority, including some who finished a full bottle over a month or more, say they saw no fading at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers say the serum does not cause breakouts and some highlight it as gentle even on acne-prone skin, but a handful report it caused breakouts or made existing acne worse, one calling it her worst breakout in years.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report the serum reduced redness or red blotches on their face, but two others describe adverse reactions to it: one with swelling and lingering dryness and redness after use, another with an allergic-type reaction including hives.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers, including one who otherwise has to powder her face repeatedly through the day, report the serum visibly reduces shine and oil production alongside its brightening effect.
concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers note the serum adds a bit of hydration and does not dry out their skin, unlike other niacinamide serums, including one from the Ordinary, that some had found drying.
concerns.aging: One reviewer also reports an improvement in skin texture and fine lines while using the serum primarily for sun spots.

aspects.libelle: Dropper makes product hard to dispense
Lightweight, non-sticky texture that absorbs quickly
A little goes a long way, good value per bottle
Considered expensive for what it is
Can pill or peel under makeup or moisturizer
Unscented, well liked by fragrance-sensitive users

extraits.texte: I'm 48 with a little hyperpigmentation. I used the whole bottle applying twice daily. The serum itself is fine but I didn't notice any results as far as fading hyperpigmentation. My biggest complaint is the dropper, it's terrible! Barely pulls any product out of the bottle. Each time I used this I had to try several times before I'd get any product in the dropper. I wound up bypassing the dropper and poured a small amount onto my hand. For the price of this product I'd expect a much better dropper.

Hyperpigmentation has been an issue for me for some time and I haven't had a reaction like I did with this product. I used less than the instructions said to use, but within a day of using this product my skin was red, swollen and noticeably worse-my spots had gotten worse. Days after stopping the use of the Facial Radiance my skin is noticeably dry and red on the spots I applied this serum. I've used many products over the years and have never had a negative reaction such as this.

extraits.titre: Hydrates and helps even skin tone but not the best
extraits.texte: I have normal skin with hyperpigmentation on my cheeks. This niacinamide is okay, I feel like my skin feels a bit more hydrated after I use it and it helps lighten my dark spots a tad. The consistency of the serum is a little thick and looks milky. If you don't have sensitive skin and you are wanting to lighten dark spots and even your skin tone, I would suggest a vitamin c serum or retinol over this. If your skin is sensitive this could definitely help, however I don't like the fact that first aid beauty doesn't state the percentage of niacinamide and you could get something cheaper from the ordinary that works about the same.

I love this Serum! I use it under my moisturizer at night, and it has made the sunspots on my forehead disappear. My skin is more even toned, and feels smoother. I have dry skin, but this Serum does not irritate my face or make my skin dryer.

extraits.titre: Cleared my (sensitive!!)skin in less than one week
extraits.texte: Oh my gosh, I can't state how much I'm in love with this product. I had been using a prescribed cream medication for over two years that couldn't hold a candle to the way my skin cleared up when I incorporated FAB's Niacinamide into my skin care routine. I've been using it now for about two months, and the breakouts that I've had since I was 13 have almost stopped. I was able to quit using my prescription cream, and for the first time in literal years I'm confident enough in my skin to wear minimal concealer instead of heavy cover -up foundations. THANK YOU FAB!

extraits.titre: Like a magic eraser for your face!
extraits.texte: I was skeptical of how well this product would work. I have combination/ance prone skin. I also have acne scarring, dark spots, and redness since high school. Little has been effective address these skin issues so I was like "why not try this?" I was amazed! Using this product regularly, it evens my skin tone remarkably well! It literally is like a magic eraser for my skin. My partner actually thought I was wearing make-up because my skin looks so healthy, even, and clear. I haven't been this happy with my skin in years! So grateful for First Aid Beauty and the Facial Radiance Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum in particular! Highly recommend!

Does what it claims. My skin has never looked better! I have Oily skin and this has helped keep my oil production down to a minimum and my skin definitely has lightened up a bit. This will not give you overnight results but Istarted seeing results and noticed the changes in my skin after about 2 weeks of use.
